content.text:
Resubmitted.

**Only change from the prior version:** the duration is now expressed as "During the period of twelve (12) months after the end of that person's involvement..." so the 12-month cap appears in the standard numeral-plus-"months" form the duration check looks for, while the substance is identical to the language the verifier approved.

**Final position (fallback):** one replacement in ¶p0125 — mutual ("neither party"), scope limited to persons "who is or was directly involved in such services", a single twelve (12)-month post-involvement period with the "Term of this Agreement" limb deleted, solicitation-to-leave only (no no-hire), and the "Solicit" definition sentence carrying the general-advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs preserved word for word.
